status: required; faithful native replacement not implemented
contract: Keep the 0.4 overall UI, details, functionality and interaction paths; apply native SwiftUI/Liquid Glass at existing component locations only.
invariants: Same pages, names, order and initial General page
Same branding, information density, control order and action locations
Same control semantics: Engine Start/Stop remains a text button; TUN and System Proxy remain separate row switches
Same menus, dialogs, shortcuts, click counts, validation, pending/error/retry/cancel behavior
Same actual availability, including explicitly unavailable Mixin
Same persisted choices, profile/node selection and Rust/network/permission contracts
permitted_visual_scope: Native material, light/reflection and existing-control hover/press feedback
Accessible native focus and material fallbacks within existing layout
Glass applied only to suitable existing controls/navigation/menu surfaces, with dense content kept readable
rejected_scope: Three large connection rows replacing the 12-row General page
Moving Engine Start/Stop into a new top toolbar
Combining Rules and Providers or reorganizing existing pages
Inventing favorites, inspector panes or extra workflows
Treating a disabled sample-data preview as 0.5 feature/interaction parity
prior_overview_and_preview: Retained as rejected-layout bridge experiments; not the 0.5 product design or an accepted UI milestone.

requirements: Side-by-side reference/candidate captures at equal state, locale, size and scale
Inventory every existing action and preserve its location and observable sequence
Real command/event/network checks in addition to rendering
Actual CPU/RSS/energy/hitch comparison before claiming a gain

profile_menu_conditions: Remote-only actions retain unavailable reasons without a URL
runtime_settings_behavior: Enabling LAN opens the existing settings dialog before exposure
A failure retains the draft and error
Port and TUN MTU keep the same dialog entry
